title: Dan Maza PA agent team structure

sourcing.good_match: GitHub repo covers it with standard n8n steps
sourcing.partial: a repo covers part, rest custom

nodes.name: Nicholas
nodes.job: Head of Ops and AI. Talks to the Orchestrator, approves posts, site changes, hires and fixes
nodes.why_it_matters: Final say on anything outward

nodes.name: Dan
nodes.job: The boss and realtor. Co-approves every post and client message
nodes.why_it_matters: Brand, clients and Fortune compliance sit with him

nodes.name: Sehab
nodes.job: Runs Meta ads; applies ad changes the Ads Analyst recommends
nodes.why_it_matters: Only person who changes the ad account

nodes.name: Orchestrator (chief of staff)
nodes.job: The one agent you talk to. Routes each request to the right department head, tracks status, returns results, holds everything outward for approval
nodes.why_it_matters: Without it you manage every agent by hand
nodes.sourcing_note: No safe repo fits; pranjalll-k supervisor template (Safe 23) usable only as a skeleton

nodes.name: Hiring Manager
nodes.job: Finds agents on GitHub for a role, safety-scans them, recommends hires, keeps the roster. Runs the Talent Scout check monthly
nodes.why_it_matters: Gate for anything new joining the team

nodes.name: Talent Scout (monthly)
nodes.job: Monthly scheduled run of the Hiring Manager: looks for better repos for each role and suggests new hires
nodes.why_it_matters: Keeps the team current without you asking
nodes.sourcing_note: A scheduled task on the Hiring Manager, not a separate agent

nodes.name: Quality Overseer
nodes.job: Weekly: scores every agent's recent work against rubrics, finds repeat mistakes, proposes instruction changes for the Friday review
nodes.why_it_matters: How the team gets better week to week
nodes.sourcing_note: paper-instruments/rubric (Safe 0, MIT) as the scorer; weekly loop is custom

nodes.name: Marketing Strategist
nodes.job: Monthly plan on the 1st, weekly briefs Mondays, intent per post; reads results
nodes.why_it_matters: Every post has a reason and a metric
nodes.sourcing_note: Published Nov 19; monthly plan runs on the 1st at 9 AM ET (first run Dec 1)

nodes.name: Content Creator
nodes.job: Cut from footage, burn subtitles, export 9:16, Drive preview
nodes.why_it_matters: The maker
nodes.sourcing_note: Published Nov 19 with Luxury editing; reads briefs, footage and the copy pack

nodes.name: Editor
nodes.job: Checks cut and copy vs Brand Kit v2 and sources; 2 revision rounds then flags Nicholas
nodes.why_it_matters: A separate checker, so the maker never grades its own work
nodes.sourcing_note: Hired Nov 19 from msitarzewski/agency-agents (Reality Checker, Evidence Collector, Brand Guardian; MIT, Safe 5) with the rubric and AgentClaimGuard approaches; frame review after render (claude-real-video later); unpublished draft

nodes.name: Ads Analyst
nodes.job: Reads Meta ad results, explains what works and what burns money, recommends changes, drafts ad copy; never edits the ad account
nodes.why_it_matters: Lower cost per lead, fair-housing safe
nodes.sourcing_note: mathiaschu/meta-ads-analyzer (Safe 5, MIT, stale) plus custom fair-housing guardrail and copy

nodes.name: Lead Research and Vetting
nodes.job: Finds the real person behind each new Follow Up Boss lead, judges money, fit and seriousness, fills CRM fields, flags missing info
nodes.why_it_matters: Dan spends time only on real buyers
nodes.sourcing_note: brian-conrya/n8n-nodes-followupboss (Safe 15, MIT) as connector; research and judgment are custom (extends the existing vetting workflow)

nodes.name: Lead Nurturing
nodes.job: Drafts personal texts and emails per lead, logs touchpoints to one profile, moves leads toward a buyer-broker agreement
nodes.why_it_matters: Follow-up that never slips
nodes.sourcing_note: No repo fits; build around the Follow Up Boss node

nodes.name: Phone agent James
nodes.job: Answers and makes calls in GoHighLevel, collects lead details, logs calls
nodes.why_it_matters: Already live; next step is the knowledge base from Dan
nodes.sourcing_note: Lives in GoHighLevel; QuickVoice (Safe 12, MIT) noted only as an open-source alternative

nodes.name: SEO and Website Agent
nodes.job: Watches Dan's project sites: SEO, AEO and GEO, speed, broken pages, backlinks; ranks fixes. Never changes a site
nodes.why_it_matters: Sites rank and stay accurate
nodes.sourcing_note: Skipped Nov 19: Sehab already has an SEO agent set up; migrate it here later. Our draft stays unpublished

nodes.name: Integration Monitor
nodes.job: Watches n8n failures, expired credentials, webhooks between Follow Up Boss, GoHighLevel, Twilio, Mailchimp and Zapier, and broken links; alerts with likely cause
nodes.why_it_matters: Catches breaks before a lead is lost
nodes.sourcing_note: kodyk448/n8n-error-alerts (Caution 30) plus lycheeverse/lychee (Safe 9, Apache) ; cross-tool checks custom

nodes.name: IT Troubleshooter
nodes.job: Takes issues from the monitor's queue, reads n8n executions, diagnoses and drafts a fix for Nicholas to apply
nodes.why_it_matters: Faster fixes, nothing changed without you
nodes.sourcing_note: czlonkowski/n8n-mcp (Safe 14, MIT, 23k stars) with a read-only key and an n8n queue

nodes.name: Finance Reporting
nodes.job: Weekly read-only report: subscriptions and AI spend, cost per lead, pipeline value, expected commissions, what to cut
nodes.why_it_matters: Cuts subscription cost, a stated goal
nodes.sourcing_note: No repo fits; ozohaustinn Sheets workflow (Caution 30, no license) is only a pattern

nodes.name: Transaction Coordinator
nodes.job: After a signing, tracks deposits, inspections, financing and closing dates, drafts reminders for approval, keeps the CRM deal current
nodes.why_it_matters: Back office last, per the plan
nodes.sourcing_note: No repo fits; ClickUp deadlines workflow (Caution 40, no license) is only a pattern

nodes.name: Copywriter
nodes.job: Hook, on-screen text, captions per platform, CTA, claim list
nodes.why_it_matters: Words that earn sends and saves without unverified claims
nodes.sourcing_note: Hired Nov 19 from coreyhaines31/marketingskills (MIT, Safe 8) with instagram-skills caption and hook rules and prosperity-real-estate-skills fair-housing rules; unpublished draft

nodes.name: Sound Designer
nodes.job: IG library audio via Meta Audio API for Reels; vetted free music elsewhere; free voiceover
nodes.why_it_matters: Calm, legal sound that makes the edit feel expensive
nodes.sourcing_note: Hired Nov 19 from msitarzewski/agency-agents audio parts (MIT, Safe 5); librosa (BPM) and Kokoro-FastAPI (free voice) planned for the render server later, not installed; unpublished draft

nodes.name: Platform Strategist
nodes.job: Per-platform spec: format, length, hook style, cover, slot, keywords; monthly playbook refresh

nodes.name: Poster
nodes.job: Publishes approved posts at slot via Meta API; logs post ID; pulls 24h and 7d results

approval_gates.name: Post approval
approval_gates.rule: Every post before it is scheduled

approval_gates.name: Client message approval
approval_gates.rule: Every text, email or reminder to a lead or client

approval_gates.name: Fix approval
approval_gates.rule: Nicholas applies fixes; agents never change credentials or live workflows

approval_gates.name: Hire approval
approval_gates.rule: Recorded only when Nicholas picks the repo

approval_gates.name: Friday review
approval_gates.rule: Instruction changes applied on Fridays after joint review

edges.label: Vetted lead with research and score
